articles.summary: Jennifer Lopez and Dolby kick off the latest installment of the “Love More in Dolby” global brand campaign with a commercial celebrating her new single “Can’t Get Enough” from her album This is Me…Now.
articles.title: Dolby and Jennifer Lopez celebrate her new album This Is Me…Now featuring single “Can’t Get Enough” in Dolby Atmos as part of the latest “Love More in Dolby” global brand campaign
